2014_spells.intellect-fortress-egw.descr: For the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
2014_spells.intellect-fortress-egw.effec: Gain resistance to psychic for the duration
2014_spells.intellect-fortress-egw.fullD: Using 1 action, for the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws. For the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws. The effect lasts for 1 hour; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
